description: Phase 1 architecture §5 provenance contract, expressed as a draft JSON Schema for backend/frontend teams to adopt. No layer accepts a record without these fields. A record missing them is flagged, never used as a fact. Draft status 2026-11-04 (Phase 2, Team A); not yet enforced by code.

freshness.description: Stale data is flagged, never presented as live. Missing sessions are recorded, never filled with estimates.

freshness_reason.description: Required when source_timestamp is null or freshness is not 'fresh'.

function_version.description: Required on derived records: the named deterministic function version that produced the number.

input_record_ids.description: Required on derived records (Layers 4-6): the stored record ids the number was computed from.

source.description: Registered source name (e.g. the PSX library actually used, or the publication for macro data). Must be a registry entry; an unregistered source fails validation.

source_timestamp.description: Timestamp as stated by the source, or null WITH a reason recorded in freshness_reason when the source gives none. Never present a null-timestamp value as live.

validation_status.description: Layers 4-6 read only 'valid' records, or explicitly flagged records where the flag is part of the analysis. 'invalid' records are never silently included.

title: Provenance contract (draft)
